about: A tool that generates command-line programs for web APIs, with docs and worked examples for each command.

prs.title: Examples with backslashes inside quotes run as written
prs.broken: Backslashes inside double quotes in an example were dropped, so a search pattern lost its meaning and the checked command was not the one the docs showed.
prs.changed: A backslash inside double quotes is now kept unless it escapes a character a shell would escape, the same way a shell reads it.
prs.matters: Generated docs and their checks now run the exact command a reader would copy.
